# Jokey, plays on his common-word name. Father died after surgery, malpractice and insurance.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
Hi there, {P2:Beth Nakamura} from intake. Am I speaking with {P1:Will Oyelaran}?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
Speaking. And yes, before you ask, I will answer your questions. Will will. Everybody does that joke, so I just get it out of the way.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
Ha, noted. Let's start with your address.
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
{A1:1620 Harbor View Boulevard, Baltimore, MD 21230}. Third floor, no elevator, you get strong or you get out.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
And email?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
{E1:will.oyelaran@gmail.com}. Same as the name, nothing clever.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
Perfect. Tell me what's going on.
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
So my dad, {P3:Chukwuemeka Oyelaran}, everyone called him {P3:Emeka}, went into St. Luke's in May for a routine hip surgery. Routine. He was seventy four, walked every day. Four days later he's gone. They say a blood clot. I say somebody dropped the ball.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
I'm so sorry. Who was the surgeon?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
A Dr. {P4:Anand Patel}. Seemed nice. Seemed confident. Said "we will monitor him closely." I have the discharge notes. They did not monitor him closely.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
Do you know who his nurse was?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
A night nurse, {P5:Cheryl}. I never got a last name. She is the one who told my sister there was a delay in giving the blood thinners.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
Your sister is?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
{P6:Joy}. {P6:Joy Oyelaran}. Yes, Will and Joy, our parents had a sense of humor. She's the oldest. Joy is a pharmacist so when she says there was a delay, I believe her.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
And your mother?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
Mom is {P7:Adaeze}. She's okay. Not okay. She keeps setting the table for three.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
I'm very sorry. What about insurance? Was there a claim?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
Two things. One, the hospital's malpractice carrier, which I assume is going to fight us. Two, Dad had accidental death coverage through his union, Local 1204. The rep there, {P8:Terrell Whitmore}, says since it was a complication it's not "accidental." I said, was it intentional?
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
That's a fair point. Do you have anything in writing from {P8:Terrell}?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
An email. I'll forward it. Will you want everything or just the denial?
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
Everything is best. The attorney will reach you at {E1:will.oyelaran@gmail.com}.
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
Oh, one more thing, since you're being so patient. The funeral home. They also tried to upsell us on a casket that cost more than my car.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
I'm sorry, that's awful. Do you remember the name of the funeral home?
• {P1:Will Oyelaran}
Greenlawn. The director was a guy named {P9:Rich}. {P9:Richard Tolliver}. Everybody called him {P9:Rich}, and I thought, well, he's not wrong, with those prices.
• {P2:Beth Nakamura}
Ha. Did you pay the bill yourselves?

My sister did. {P6:Joy} put it on a card. She keeps the receipts in a shoebox, and she's a pharmacist, so you know the shoebox is organized.

Good. Those receipts will matter for damages. Who else was at the hospital?

My uncle {P10:Ifeanyi} flew in from Lagos. Mom's cousin, {P11:Nkechi}, too. And a priest, Father {P12:Okonkwo}. He prayed with Dad the night before. He asked me not to go to the press. I said, Father, I'm not going to the press. I'm going to you people.
